projects.summary: Part of the several LLM / Apertus projects listed by MLO. Explores novel LLM architectures, including efficient long-context or mixture-of-experts mechanisms. Students apply via the application form.

projects.title: Optimization dynamics for LLMs (Muon and AdEMAmix variants, interactions with architecture)
projects.summary: Part of the several LLM / Apertus projects listed by MLO. Studies optimization dynamics for LLM training, e.g. Muon and AdEMAmix variants and their interactions with architecture. Students apply via the application form.

projects.title: LLM inference on old V100 GPUs
projects.summary: New project for fall 2026. Aims to make recent large open-weight MoE models run on the EPFL cluster of V100 GPUs and compare with newer GPUs, using quantization, communication-efficient parallelism and inference frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

projects.title: Communication-efficient gossip methods for replacing all-reduce in distributed LLM training
projects.summary: New project for fall 2026. Implements decentralized pairwise weight averaging instead of all-to-all communication for distributed LLM pre-training, and studies model and data parallelism settings and communication compression.

projects.title: AI safety evaluations feeding back into Apertus Posttraining
projects.summary: New project for fall 2026. Works with UN agencies such as UNICC to incorporate findings from red-teaming studies into the safety SFT and RL post-training recipes for the next Apertus generation.

projects.title: LLM Pretraining Data Curation
projects.summary: Updated for fall 2026. Aims to go beyond baselines such as FineWeb-2 HQ using new techniques for signal extraction, semantic filtering and partially synthetic augmentation or rephrasing, in English or multilingual settings. One idea is to study the impact of data quality on the curse of multilinguality and scaling laws.

projects.title: Learning to sample on the fly for SGD / curriculum learning
projects.summary: An auxiliary network learns to assign scores to training data points, which are then used to select an improved set of training points. Several ways to train the auxiliary parameters will be explored.

projects.title: Improving factuality understanding for LLM training
projects.summary: Plans to add a per-document factuality tag or masking to guide LLM training on what is factual, with the goal of enhancing factuality and reducing hallucinations. Post-training techniques may also be investigated.

projects.title: Build decentralized LLMs in the browser
projects.summary: Practical project within a larger team effort to build decentralized, federated training software (DISCO) in which many clients, such as phones or hospitals, collaboratively train a joint model such as a small LLM while preserving data privacy. Mostly JavaScript/TypeScript, with Rust integration of Burn.
